Optional: vendor Three.js for offline / fully self-hosted use.
Download https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.min.js
and save it here as js/vendor/three.module.min.js. The game tries this file first,
then falls back to the jsDelivr CDN. Three.js is MIT licensed (https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js).
